name: In Search of Knowledge
summary: Troyas Moonbreeze sends you to seek Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village. He found a stave in the rubble of Feralas and wants to learn what it is.

sections.title: An Ordinary Stave
sections.body: Troyas Moonbreeze says the ruins of Feralas are dangerous, yet they have much to tell of what happened there. A few days ago, he searched the rubble to the south and found a stave that seemed ordinary. Still, he feels there is more to it. He and Angelas searched their books, but found no word of the stave.

sections.title: A Colleague in Darnassus
sections.body: Troyas has a colleague in Darnassus who may know what the stave is. He asks you to speak with Daryn Lightwind in Rut'theran Village.

sections.title: Daryn's Reply
sections.body: Daryn Lightwind grumbles that Troyas keeps pestering her with wild notions about finding something important. She thinks the ogres or harpies now living in the ruins probably carried off anything truly valuable long ago. You are welcome to look around, she says, though she doubts the books there will help.

faq.q: Who sends you to Daryn Lightwind?
aliases: who starts in search of knowledge
faq.answer: Troyas Moonbreeze sends you to Daryn because he wants to learn what the stave he found in the Feralas ruins really is.
Troyas found a stave in the rubble to the south of where he works. It seems ordinary, but he feels there is more to it.
Daryn Lightwind is in Rut'theran Village. Troyas describes her as a colleague in Darnassus.

faq.q: Why does Troyas send you to Daryn?
faq.answer: Troyas and Angelas found nothing about the stave in their books. Daryn may be able to tell them what it is.
